{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/trial.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Identify the highest sample_seq for each patient_id
# This ensures we keep only the most recent (and likely final) observation per patient
data = data.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
data = data.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check the value counts for 'severity' to see how many are 'severe'
severity_counts = data['severity'].value_counts()

# Calculate the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
fraction_severe = severity_counts.get('severe', 0) / len(data)

# Print the result
fraction_severe"}
